environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in a VPC private subnet with a NAT Gateway providing internet egress. The function is invoked via API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint). The Lambda execution role has ssm:PutParameter and ssm:GetParameter permissions. The VPC has standard routing: private subnet → NAT GW → IGW. No WAF is attached to the API Gateway stage. Security groups allow all outbound traffic.

config.lambda_role_policy: ssm:PutParameter, ssm:GetParameter, logs:*, ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces, ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
